summary_en: This study tests interferon gamma-1b (ACTIMMUNE) given together with donor leukocyte infusion (DLI) in adults whose acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndromes returned after an allogeneic stem cell transplant. Interferon gamma-1b is given as 100 mcg three times a week for 4 weeks, then the same schedule for 4 more weeks, then 100 mcg weekly for 4 weeks. DLI doses are given based on clinical assessment, with the first dose at 10^6 CD3+ cells/kg and a possible second dose at 10^7 CD3+ cells/kg in the haploidentical cohort. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it is a Phase 2 study that aims to confirm efficacy seen in a prior Phase 1 trial and to evaluate safety.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el interferón gamma-1b (ACTIMMUNE) administrado junto con infusión de linfocitos del donante (DLI) en adultos con leucemia mieloide aguda o síndromes mielodisplásicos que recayeron después de un trasplante alogénico de células madre. El interferón gamma-1b se administra a 100 mcg tres veces por semana durante 4 semanas, luego con el mismo esquema por 4 semanas más, y después 100 mcg semanales por 4 semanas. Las dosis de DLI se administran según la evaluación clínica, con una primera dosis de 10^6 células CD3+/kg y una posible segunda dosis de 10^7 células CD3+/kg en la cohorte de donante haploidéntico. El registro no indica un resultado principal; es un estudio de Fase 2 que busca confirmar la eficacia observada en un estudio previo de Fase 1 y evaluar la seguridad.
who_for: Acute myeloid leukemia or myelodysplastic syndromes that relapsed after allogeneic stem cell transplant, with measurable disease.
A donor lymphocyte infusion is available, or the donor is willing to undergo apheresis.
Willing to give signed consent, follow study procedures, and use contraception as required.
not_for: Grade 3 or 4 acute GVHD at enrollment, or a history of grade 4 acute GVHD.
Moderate or severe chronic GVHD at enrollment.
Known hypersensitivity to interferon gamma or E. coli-derived products.
Certain heart, lung, seizure, liver, or kidney conditions as listed, such as AST or ALT above 5 times ULN or CrCl below 30 mL/min.
Positive pregnancy test or currently breastfeeding.
